recentItems.title: JIAOHUN - Official Gameplay Trailer
recentItems.description:
Don't miss the gameplay trailer for JIAOHUN, a first-person psychological horror game from 12AM BLACKOUT. Set in 1999, just before the arrival of the new millenium, you explore Fairy Town, a town caught between changing tides. Step into the darkness and learn the truth at the heart of Fairy Town's downfall. 

JIAOHUN launches on PC (Steam) and PlayStation 5 (PS5) in 2027!

recentItems.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3, Episodes 1-4 Review
recentItems.description:
In Season 3’s first four episodes, The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power smartly gets back to basics. Although not big on epic fight scenes, the real attraction here is the series recalibrating itself, streamlining its plotlines and reminding us that this is, like the original Peter Jackson film trilogy, a simple but compelling story about good needing to triumph over evil. All the show’s most necessary players are back on the board with renewed vigor in what’s a clear attempt at bringing in new viewers to the Prime Video series, while hopefully not alienating those who have stuck with the show thus far.

Episodes 1-4 are available on Prime Video now, with Episodes 5 and 6 debuting on Nov. 18, and Episodes 7 and 8 finishing out the season on Nov. 25.

#IGN

recentItems.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake - All 6 Great Fairy Fountain Locations and Rewards
recentItems.description:
There are six Great Fairy Fountains hidden throughout _The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake_, and finding them will reward you with powerful upgrades and abilities, including Din's Fire, Farore's Wind, Nayru's Love, Double Magic, and Double Defense. This guide shows you where to find every Great Fairy Fountain, how to access each hidden entrance, and what rewards you'll receive for visiting them.

We'll take you through all six locations, including Death Mountain Trail, Hyrule Castle, Zora Fountain, Death Mountain Crater, the Evil Desert Colossus, and Ganondorf's Castle. Whether you're looking to unlock every Great Fairy ability or simply want to track down the remaining fountains, this walkthrough has everything you need.

For more guides, walkthroughs, and tips, check out IGN's _The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake_ Strategy Guide!

recentItems.title: Rockstar Confirms GTA 6 Will Run at 30fps On All Consoles - IGN Daily Fix
recentItems.description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Rockstar has revealed more of the technical details of GTA 6 on consoles. The game will be aiming for 30 frames per second on Xbox Series X|S, PS5, and PS5 Pro. The PS5 Pro will get more advanced ray-tracing features. However, this comes to the disappointment of some gamers who were hoping for 60fps or at least a performance mode aiming for 40fps on PS5 Pro. But that still hasn't stopped the wave of excitement for what is looking to be the biggest gaming launch of all time: GTA 6 is now the most preloaded game in PlayStation and Xbox history. Sony and Microsoft are urging fans to preload the game before its launch on November 19th, as network services will likely be bottlenecked by the sheer demand for this game. And finally, The Hollywood Reporter has revealed a few details surrounding James Gunn and Peter Safran's ousting at DC Studios.
